scope: Three sequential evidence-based reviews of the recovery readback and conservative encryption gate, including official firmware/component and hardware-identity compatibility. No live router changes or authentication capability expansion.

rounds.focus: UCI native return values and configuration absence evidence across versions
rounds.finding: The old ! uci get condition accepted any lookup failure as evidence of absence. A POSIX regression proved a remaining section could be reported absent.
rounds.repair: Require successful complete UCI reads before testing absent section/option prefixes. Keep stdout restricted to a fixed completion token; no raw configuration is returned.

rounds.focus: Runtime identity and original-state preservation during cancellation/error cleanup
findings: Malformed network rows without an interface identity could incorrectly prove the temporary network absent.
Previously nonrunning original interfaces that became active were not detected.
Invalid/overlong kernel interface names were accepted as running evidence.
repairs: Validate complete unique nonempty logical network identities.
Compare original and recovered interface-running flags in both directions.
Validate kernel interface identity using byte length and Linux primary-name restrictions.

rounds.focus: Cross-version source contracts, diagnostic export and security-label compatibility
findings: The new recovery operation/stage/reason constants were not registered at the export allowlist boundary; password_restore_check was removed as a sensitive string.
802.1X standard punctuation split the enterprise token and could allow a contradictory label containing PSK.
repairs: Register fixed recovery metadata in the shared diagnostic schema without allowing raw content.
Normalize standard 802.1X spelling before the conservative enterprise rejection.

compatibility.hardware: Shared capability/ownership path; preceding five-model boundary identity evidence retained. No radio numbering, model-to-band or CPU-architecture-only shortcut added.
hardware_not_certified: Wireless runtime correctness on every model

validation.skip_reason: Existing test requires Debian/POSIX execution and is skipped on this Windows host; generated recovery commands separately executed locally with Git Bash.

remaining_limits: Readback is a single bounded observation after the existing reload; pending state remains unconfirmed, with no forced retry/reload.
Recovery checks configuration and exposed interface runtime, not Internet connectivity or complete upstream association.
Full UCI listing is held only in the short-lived remote shell; it is not exported or written by the checker.
Passing review and local tests does not prove absence of all bugs or universal hardware compatibility.
